0x0007F6.en: 「As I am now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000867.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008EF.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000969.en: 「So this is... as far as I go...?」

0x000A18.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...!?」

0x000A50.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B54.en: 「No way I'm blowing it here...!@　Not fun at all...」

0x000BA8.en: 「I screwed up...!@　Guess I've got no choice but to bail...」

0x000CF9.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is on you.」

0x000D67.en: 「Grrgh! Got the worse of that one...」

0x000DA5.en: 「No good, took too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000DF2.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E30.en: 「Kyah! The rest is in your hands!」

0x000E77.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F22.en: 「Ngh... to think I'd become a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x000FD9.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give. Miscalculated, that's all.」

0x00101A.en: 「Aw shoot, they done got me good!」

0x00105E.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x0010CB.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001112.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001147.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x00118B.en: 「I can't fight anymore! I'm pulling back!」

0x001204.en: 「Ngh... You're good, I'll give you that.」

0x001233.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@　I'm still too green...!」

0x001281.en: 「No good, I can't hold out! Retreating!」

0x0013D8.en: 「I can't manage any more. Please excuse me.」

0x001463.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull out for now...!」

0x0017C7.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x0017F6.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x001925.en: 「<ＲＥＢ>'s core is shielded within the field,@　so hold nothing back. Give it everything you've got.」

0x00199B.en: 「You don't have to tell me twice!」

0x0019D2.en: 「All units, wipe out the Demon Golems!」

0x001A09.en: 「Mmh... That thing's putting up more of a fight than I expected...!」

0x001A4F.en: 「Don't go weak on me now, granny!@　Keep the REB's fake personality locked down tight!」

0x001AE8.en: 「Mmh, this is bad... The fake personality is waking up.」

0x001B72.en: 「That fool Ybun...@　To think he'd try to seal away one so noble and elegant,@　the sovereign of all worlds, the omniscient Gatheserk...」

0x001C11.en: 「You lowly fake personality.@　If you'd rather not be erased on the spot, begone at once.」

0x001C79.en: 「Heh heh heh... Talk all you like,@　you can't demean me. I can hear them,@　the anguish in your hearts, the screams of despair.」

0x001D27.en: 「So that's the fake personality that possessed the <ＲＥＢ>!」

0x001D9A.en: 「Do not move.@　Wound me, and the summoning magic will be useless to you.」

0x001DF9.en: 「Tch, so he knew our aim all along...!」

0x001E3F.en: 「I am the omniscient god,@　the demon-god who brings calamity to La Gias.」

0x001EA4.en: 「Demon-god, my foot! You're just a low demon!」

0x001EDE.en: 「Preying on our weakness like that,@　he certainly lives up to the name.」

0x001F41.en: 「But if Gatheserk completely takes over@　the Solatis Temple, wouldn't something terrible@　happen to Langran...!?」

0x002045.en: 「Ybun, is that computer@　truly indispensable?@　Beyond sending us back to our world, I mean.」

0x0020D5.en: 「...No, we've a backup of the vital data,@　and it's rarely used for anything short of@　large-scale magic like the summoning spell.」

0x002174.en: 「Then maybe it'd be OK to just wreck it?」

0x0021C4.en: 「Wait!@　Then we'd have no way home!」

0x002211.en: 「We're not going back right this second anyway...@　It can be repaired later, can't it?」

0x00228E.en: 「Besides, there are other ways home, right?@　Your Cybuster can travel between the surface@　and La Gias all on its own, after all.」

0x002364.en: 「...What? What are you lot talking about?」

0x0023CC.en: 「Then our priority is settling this mess.@　Captain, what do you say?」

0x002428.en: 「No objections. As things stand, we can't very well@　return to the surface on our own.」

0x0024D4.en: 「Rio said it herself the other day.@　Now it's our turn to help you.」

0x00257F.en: 「Very well. I'll not have Gatheserk running amok,@　so let's give up on the REB.@　Do as you please.」

0x002667.en: 「Aye. Leaving you in control of it,@　there's no telling what you'd do.」

0x0026F0.en: 「Wait, let's talk. We can work this out.」

0x00276E.en: 「Hear me out.@　If I, the omnipotent, the world's conqueror,@　were to get serious, you'd all...」

0x0027E9.en: 「I've no interest in talking to a low demon.」

0x002823.en: 「Yeah!@　We'll smash you and the REB together!」

0x002870.en: 「Nnngh...!@　Then I shall deal with you myself...!」

0x002969.en: 「He's a low demon after all!@　Granny, do it!」

0x0029D9.en: 「Heh, you fell for it!@　With the barrier up, you can't possess@　the REB anymore!」

0x002AA6.en: 「Hehe, he was more gullible than I thought.」

0x002AE3.en: 「Puny humans, daring to challenge me!@　You know not your place!」

0x002B8F.en: 「I-impossible!@　That I, the omnipotent god, should faaall!!」

0x002C04.en: 「No, it seems someone slipped in here@　amid all the confusion.」

0x002CD9.en: 「A surface machine...?@　But it's a type I've never seen.」

0x002D29.en: 「You lot are the Steel Dragon Squadron, right?@　I've heard all kinds of rumors about you.」

0x002D8C.en: 「Name's Chienne Argent.@　One of the <Boosted Children>.」

0x002E1C.en: 「Yeah.@　But don't lump me in with small fry@　like Bronzo 28 or 27.」

0x002E85.en: 「I'm Argent Class...@　And now that Aurum 1 is dead,@　I'm the top of the Boosted Children.」

0x002F27.en: 「Latooni mentioned there were@　survivors among the Boosted Children,@　but...」

0x002FA5.en: 「Don't tell me she underwent the Rimacon too...!?」

0x002FE5.en: 「Hah! Don't go comparing me@　to those drugged-up wrecks.@　This line of work just suits me.」

0x003075.en: 「Besides, there's good money to be made in this world...@　and with you lot as my targets, all the better.」

0x0030FB.en: 「Who are you with?@　Don't tell me you're a <Neue DC> remnant?」

0x003159.en: 「No reason to tell you that.@　As long as I earn my keep, any battlefield will do.」

0x0031D6.en: 「She's got a very different feel from Arado and the others.」

0x003210.en: 「Hmph, those are defective goods.@　The true form a Boosted Child should take@　is me.」

0x0032A9.en: 「Who cares!@　If you're picking a fight with us, we'll oblige!」

0x003308.en: 「Haha, that's more like it! Here I come!」

0x003345.en: 「Tch, the Kerberion's...!@　Poor tuning's biting me now!@　I'll back off for today!」

0x0033E2.en: 「Why did she even come all the way out here?」

0x00342B.en: 「She had a mercenary air about her.@　Maybe she's hired by the Shutedonias army,@　or maybe she just came gunning for us...」

0x0034D6.en: （This surface-summoning business...@　It won't be settled anytime soon, huh...）

0x003541.en: 「I'll clean up these Golems in a flash!」

0x003581.en: 「In this world, Magic Mechs are prime game, they say!」

0x003610.en: 「To think there'd be a Boosted Child@　like you.」

0x003666.en: 「I told you! I'm the real deal!」

0x0036A3.en: 「Taking down an ATX Team member@　would make a fine trophy!」

0x003702.en: 「Push your luck too far and it'll cost you, girlie!」

0x003748.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Riot State, Solatis Temple

0x0037A7.en: 「...Thanks to you lot,@　we managed to erase Gatheserk.@　You have my gratitude.」

0x003854.en: （Masaki really milked that for all it was worth...）

0x00388E.en: 「Still, everyone put on quite a performance.」

0x0038C8.en: 「Performance, or... it was half the truth, too.」

0x003902.en: 「Yeah. It really is a fact that we can't just@　head back to the surface alone.」

0x00396A.en: 「But at this rate, we'll get dragged deeper@　and deeper into the war between@　Langran and Shutedonias.」

0x0039EE.en: 「Well, it's not someone else's problem anymore.」

0x003A22.en: 「For our part, we're better off@　sticking with you. Seems you're@　quite the celebrity in Langran.」

0x003AE9.en: 「Besides, we can't just ignore people like@　that Chienne girl from before, who seem to be@　Neue DC remnants.」

0x003B8E.en: 「That girl's machine...@　I think it's probably a new Lion series model.」

0x003C2D.en: 「If it were a Federation machine,@　it wouldn't have come at us like that...@　So it's Neue DC remnants and Isurugi after all?」

0x003CD8.en: （Maybe it's tied to the GS somehow...）

0x003D1B.en: 「We have our suspicions about Isurugi.@ Before we came to La Gias, we ran into@ the Vegalion...」

0x003DCD.en: 「Like my Altairlion, it's a finished unit@ in the <Project TD> Series 77.」

0x003E46.en: 「Don't tell me it got stolen from you?」

0x003E89.en: 「No, the only one we built was the Altairlion...」

0x003ED9.en: 「The Vegalion we saw was something Isurugi@　built on their own, off of Filio's@　blueprints, I think...」

0x003F6F.en: 「But we ended up in La Gias right after@　we ran into it, so there's no way for us@　to look into the details...」

0x004018.en: 「...What will you do now, Lord Masaki?」

0x004074.en: 「First we head for the royal capital.@ Prince Feil is headed there too, and above@ all, I fear for the captive Princess Monica.」

0x004141.en: 「Aye. My senses warn me of trouble.@　Something is closing in on the princess.」

0x0041B5.en: 「Got it. We're going to the capital.@　We might link up with Prince Feil, and@　we've got to rescue Princess Monica.」

0x00424E.en: 「A princess, huh... I wonder what she's like.」

0x0042BD.en: 「The fighting's only going to get harder@　from here. No matter how ready you are...」

0x004322.en: 「I've started to like this world.@　Sure, there are hard times, but...」

0x004399.en: 「But being in La Gias, I feel like I@　might get back something precious@　I'd lost.」

0x00446E.en: 「Yeah, we're off to the capital. I'll lead the way.」

0x0044A8.en: 「I'll pass on that, thanks.@　Torres, if you would.」
